title: Multi-Run Sequential Analysis Design
description: Whether the protocol uses a single acquisition pass or multiple sequential runs on the same sample location, each optimized for different analytical objectives. For multi-run designs, describe the number of runs, their purpose, key laser and instrument settings per run, and how outputs of one run feed into data reduction of another. Not applicable to raster mapping, where each spatial location is visited exactly once.
